subject: Cascade Midstream Partners, LLC - $700MM First Lien Term Loan B - Launch
body:
Ashgrove Capital Markets is pleased to announce the launch of the $700,000,000 First Lien Term Loan B for Cascade Midstream Partners, LLC.

SUMMARY OF TERMS

Borrower:            Cascade Midstream Partners, LLC
Facility:            First Lien Term Loan B
Size:                $700,000,000
Ratings:             TBA
Maturity:            7 Years
Margin:              S+275-300
Floor:               0.00%
OID:                 99.00-99.50
Call Protection:     101 Soft Call until the later of (i) 12 months or (ii) In Service Date
Amortization:        None
Financial Covenant:  1.05x DSCR
ECF Sweep:           50% > 6.00x, 25% > 5.50x, 0% <= 5.50x
Use of Proceeds:     Fund Project Costs and pay interest, fees and expenses during construction
Bookrunners:         Ashgrove Capital Markets (Lead Left) / Kestrel Bank / Blue Ridge Financial
Administrative Agent: Ashgrove Capital Markets

TIMING

Lender Conference Call: Wednesday, March 11, 2026 at 4:00PM ET
Dial-in: +1 (555) 010-0142, Access Code 884 201
Commitments Due: Wednesday, March 18th at 12PM ET

Deal materials are available on the arranger deal site (https://dealsite.ashgrove-cm.example/cascade). Please contact your Ashgrove Capital Markets salesperson with any questions.

This communication is intended for the addressee only and is not an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy any security.
